'''March 2001 Abbotsford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Abbotsford, BC on 4 March 2001. It is known from Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1847">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-abbotsford-bc-03-04-01d1847/ abbotsford-bc-03-04-01], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-abbotsford-bc-03-04-01d1847/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Abbotsford, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
